pieces.text: paudi oxine Banate hain Jiska upyog Manushya saans lene mein Karte hain aur ve carbon dioxide lite hain jo Manushya saath se chhodte hain yani saans chhodte hain
pieces.translation: Plants produce oxygen, which humans use for breathing, and they release carbon dioxide, which humans exhale along with their breath.

pieces.text: Pon padaarth se bani hain sare padaarth sookshm kadon se bhi bh hain Jinhen bhavyuononon
pieces.translation: All substances are made of matter, and all substances are filled with subtle particles, which are called atoms.

pieces.text: aamtaur par aap Hamesha paryatkon aur bechne walon ki awaaz sunte Hain. Dhvani aur prakash Kih Kahani par aap h
pieces.translation: Usually you always listen to the voices of tourists and sellers. You are on the story of sound and light.

pieces.text: Jiske parinam swaroop manch par Kalaakaar ganje bhari cigarette peete hain aur ye theater khud darshakon ko bhi iske saath shamil hone ke liye prerit Karte hain
pieces.translation: As a result, artists smoke heavily marijuana cigarettes on stage, and this theater also inspires the audience to participate in it as well.

pieces.text: Baad banne ke Baad Moushumi Baar jo poore nadi mein thijar nau sau bhi Baar ruk Gon
pieces.translation: After becoming Baad, Moushumi Baar, who has stopped nine hundred times in the entire river, Gon.

pieces.text: rajyapal ke karyalay ne bataya ki ghayalon mein se Unees police adhikari the.
pieces.translation: The state governor's office said that among the injured were nineteen police officers.

pieces.text: - n kasht ki motai karib sattar kilometer hai aur sabse door kesare par Yadav kilometer hai unhone aage kaha
pieces.translation: - The distance to Kasht ki Motai is about seventy kilometers, and the farthest is Yadav kilometer away, they said further.

pieces.text: lene ke liye nahin kaha jaana chahiye jo unke vikas ke charan jimmedari aur kshamtaon se pare hai
pieces.translation: One should not be told to take something that is beyond the responsibility and abilities of their developmental stage.

pieces.text: bhi sankhya Jitni choti hogi chumbaki utkraman ke sambandh Meinhi tar utna hi kam sankriya hoga
pieces.translation: The smaller the number, the less active the magnet will be in terms of magnetic alignment.

pieces.text: yeh samudra ke neeche patla aur oonche kshetron mein Neecha mota Hota hai
pieces.translation: This becomes thinner and thicker in the lower, thicker areas under the sea.

pieces.text: - j to yeh kai logon ke liye achchi dost Thi.
pieces.translation: - j was a good friend to many people.

pieces.text: ke anucched ke tahat krantikari yudh ke dauraan terah rajya se pahli Baar ek kamjor kendra sarkar ka gathan kiya jismen Congress Iska ekamatr ghatak thi
pieces.translation: Under this provision, during the revolutionary war, for the first time, a weak central government was formed from thirteen states, in which the Congress was its only opposition party.

pieces.text: - g greek ka gyan ghatta gaya pashchim ne khud ka apni greek Gonon gaayanasa aur va jonse kata hua
pieces.translation: - The knowledge of Greek declined; the West cut off its own Greek language and culture.

pieces.text: on Kehte hue ki ve China ke aarthik utpadan ke adhara par banae jenge unhone katauti ke liye Koi-onkraharit nahin kiya
pieces.translation: While saying that they will be built based on China's economic production, they did not make any restriction for cutting.

pieces.text: aerosmith ne apne daure ke apne se sangeet karyakramon ko radd kar Diya hai
pieces.translation: Aerosmith has canceled its music programs during its tour.

pieces.text: mein aabadi bahut hi kam hai aur kuch ilakon mein lagbhagt koi Insani aabadi hai hi Non
pieces.translation: The population is very low now, and in some areas there is almost no human population at all.

pieces.text: patli hone ke Kaaran aas paas par kai mariyan hongi lava ke liye satah par bharna aasan Tha
pieces.translation: Because it is thin, there will be many cracks around; it was easy to fill the surface with lava.

pieces.text: hone vaali bhasha hai Jise rajya mein kaam karne vaaleon jh jhadakarshanah isonon hain Jabhi jhadononon istem hai
pieces.translation: It is the language that is spoken by those who work in the state, and these are the speakers when they use it.

pieces.text: kaisa Blanka morocco mein kharidari karne ke liye sabse kam dilchasp sthanon mein se ek Hai.
pieces.translation: Blanka is one of the least interesting places to shop in Morocco.

pieces.text: unhone nafaon ko rajnitik bakwas aur muktapon Kaha.
pieces.translation: They called the profits political nonsense and bribes.
